dialogues.jp:
歌声が、花びらと一緒に、木立の合間を流れて
いる。
dialogues.en:
Her singing voice, like the flower petals, flowed throughout
the forest.
dialogues.text:
Her singing voice, like the flower petals, flowed throughout
the forest.

dialogues.jp: ことりが、姉である暦先生の結婚に贈る歌。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was practicing her gift for her sister's wedding
ceremony.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was practicing her gift for her sister's wedding
ceremony.

dialogues.jp:
以前のような外国の曲じゃなくて、日本の曲だ
から、詩もはっきりと聞き取れる。
dialogues.en:
Unlike the last time where they chose to perform a foreign
song, this time the song was purely Japanese.
dialogues.text:
Unlike the last time where they chose to perform a foreign
song, this time the song was purely Japanese.

dialogues.jp:
だからだろうか。注意していないと、不意に、
涙ぐみそうになってしまう。
dialogues.en: Her singing could easily bring tears to the sensitive.
dialogues.text: Her singing could easily bring tears to the sensitive.

dialogues.jp: やっぱりことりは、大した歌い手だった。
dialogues.en: Kotori really is an amazing singer.
dialogues.text: Kotori really is an amazing singer.

dialogues.jp: 熱くなってきた｛まぶた／瞼｝を閉じて、歌に聞き入る。
dialogues.en:
I close my hot eyelids, and let my sense of hearing take
over.
dialogues.text:
I close my hot eyelids, and let my sense of hearing take
over.

dialogues.jp:
身体の奥深くまで染み込んでくるような、その
声に……。
dialogues.en: I let my body be taken over by that voice...
dialogues.text: I let my body be taken over by that voice...

dialogues.jp:
何度めかの曲の終わり。ことりは、大木の陰か
らすっと出てきた。
dialogues.en:
Some time after the song ended, Kotori emerged from behind
the big sakura tree.
dialogues.text:
Some time after the song ended, Kotori emerged from behind
the big sakura tree.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こんなものかな」
dialogues.en: "That's it..."
dialogues.text: "That's it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「もう、完璧なんじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Seems flawless to me."
dialogues.text: "Seems flawless to me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そう……だね。歌詞は頭に入ったし、呼吸の
　リズムも覚えたし……」
dialogues.en:
"I... guess so. All the lyrics are etched in my brain, I
remembered when to breathe to maintain the rhythm..."
dialogues.text:
"I... guess so. All the lyrics are etched in my brain, I
remembered when to breathe to maintain the rhythm..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん。後は、当日までこの感じを忘れないよ
　うにすれば、ＯＫかな」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. From now till the day itself, it'd take a bout of
amnesia to make me forget it all."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. From now till the day itself, it'd take a bout of
amnesia to make me forget it all."

dialogues.jp: 鼻をぐすぐすやりながら、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: She giggled a little. I opened my mouth.
dialogues.text: She giggled a little. I opened my mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、ことりの歌は最高だな」
dialogues.en: "Your singing really is the best."
dialogues.text: "Your singing really is the best."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「おおげさだよ。それに、どこまで行ったって、
　完璧って事はないからね」
dialogues.en:
"That's exagerrating... besides, singing is one of the
things that can never be truly perfect."
dialogues.text:
"That's exagerrating... besides, singing is one of the
things that can never be truly perfect."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、早く来ないかな……」
dialogues.en: "I just wish it'd come sooner..."
dialogues.text: "I just wish it'd come sooner..."

dialogues.jp: 指を折り、何かを数える。
dialogues.en: She started folding her fingers, as if counting something.
dialogues.text: She started folding her fingers, as if counting something.

dialogues.jp: 「結婚式？」
dialogues.en: "The wedding ceremony?"
dialogues.text: "The wedding ceremony?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「というか、ゴールデンウィーク。ＴＤＬ、楽
　しみだなって」
dialogues.en: "Golden Week, I meant. The TDL will be really fun."
dialogues.text: "Golden Week, I meant. The TDL will be really fun."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ええと、５月の３日まで、後ちょうど１週間
　か。４月って、３０日までだよね？」
dialogues.en:
"Let's see, the 3rd of May is in roughly one week. April
only has 30 days, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Let's see, the 3rd of May is in roughly one week. April
only has 30 days, right?"

dialogues.jp: うなずいて、俺は言った。
dialogues.en: I nodded, and added to the conversation.
dialogues.text: I nodded, and added to the conversation.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、あんまりはしゃぎ過ぎて、ダウンしな
　いでくれよな。ほんとに大切なのは、その後
　に控えてるんだからさ」
dialogues.en:
"But this time, you'd better make sure you don't fall sick
before. You may have to skip the TDL if worst comes to
worst..."
dialogues.text:
"But this time, you'd better make sure you don't fall sick
before. You may have to skip the TDL if worst comes to
worst..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え〜、私、ダウンなんてしないよ」
dialogues.en: "Eh~~, I won't fall sick!"
dialogues.text: "Eh~~, I won't fall sick!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……卒パの時を思い出すに、そこはかとなく
　説得力がないな」
dialogues.en:
"...After what happened at the graduation party, that
doesn't convince me very much."
dialogues.text:
"...After what happened at the graduation party, that
doesn't convince me very much."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あれは、そのぉ……不可抗力」
dialogues.en: "That, was... an act of God."
dialogues.text: "That, was... an act of God."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もしはしゃぎすぎるようだったら、ずっと観
　覧車に乗り続ける」
dialogues.en:
"If that really were to happen again, I won't let you ride
anything but the ferris wheel."
dialogues.text:
"If that really were to happen again, I won't let you ride
anything but the ferris wheel."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「密室……ずっとふたりきりで何するの？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, what would the two of us do there for so long..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, what would the two of us do there for so long..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なっ、バっ……！」
dialogues.en: "W, what are you...!"
dialogues.text: "W, what are you...!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あはははは」
dialogues.en: "Ahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
振り上げた拳に、ことりは頭を抱えて逃げるよ
うにした。
dialogues.en:
Kotori ran away laughing, escaping from my jokingly raised
fist.
dialogues.text:
Kotori ran away laughing, escaping from my jokingly raised
fist.

dialogues.jp:
逃げる方も追いかける方も、もちろん分かって
やっている。
dialogues.en: Of course, I knew where she would run off to.
dialogues.text: Of course, I knew where she would run off to.

dialogues.jp:
程なくして俺はことりに追いつき、ぽてっと、
帽子の上に手の平を置いた。
dialogues.en:
I eventually caught up with her, patting her hat with my
palm.
dialogues.text:
I eventually caught up with her, patting her hat with my
palm.

dialogues.jp: 「隙あり、ってな」
dialogues.en: "Gotcha."
dialogues.text: "Gotcha."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、バイバイ。また、明日」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, bye bye. I'd see you tomorrow."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, bye bye. I'd see you tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、うん。じゃ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, later."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, later."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ちゅっ」
dialogues.en: "*kiss*"
dialogues.text: "*kiss*"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あはは。隙ありぃっ」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, gotcha!"
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, gotcha!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「結婚式も大事だけど、ＴＤＬだって大事なん
　だからねっ。それじゃ、バイバ〜イ！」
dialogues.en:
"The wedding ceremony is important, but the TDL is important
too. Now for real, bye bye!"
dialogues.text:
"The wedding ceremony is important, but the TDL is important
too. Now for real, bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……帰ろう」
dialogues.en: "...Time to head back."
dialogues.text: "...Time to head back."

dialogues.jp:
途端に物寂しく静かになった公園に、呟きがす
うっと流れていった。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly feeling lonely, my sigh disappeared into the sakura
park.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly feeling lonely, my sigh disappeared into the sakura
park.

dialogues.jp: ◆姉へ贈る歌◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Song to My Sister◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Song to My Sister◆

dialogues.jp:
ことりが歌を歌っている。その歌声は心に染み
渡ってくるようで……。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was singing a song. Her singing voice left a deep
impression on one's heart...
dialogues.text:
Kotori was singing a song. Her singing voice left a deep
impression on one's heart...

dialogues.jp:
この分なら多分、暦先生も喜んでくれる事だろ
う。
dialogues.en: I'm sure Koyomi-sensei would be pleased by it.
dialogues.text: I'm sure Koyomi-sensei would be pleased by it.
